title: Chapter 398 Black Bear Spirit
content:
Chapter 398 Black Bear Spirit

"Damn human, how dare you be so arrogant, wait for me to teach him a lesson."

In the monster army formation, there was a fat monster general with a fierce face roaring, and also rushed out, rushing towards Chen Wu who was still showing off his might.

The demon general looked burly, but he moved quite quickly, like a loach, he crossed several kilometers in a few strokes, and came straight to Cheng Wu.

This is the black bear spirit who ranks fifth in the demon army and is known as the mountain god.

This black bear-turned-spirited demon general has great strength throughout his life, and his skin is rough and fleshy, and his physical defense is well-known even among the monster clans that are famous for their physical strength.

His most powerful feat was in a battle with a small mountain god, he drew his natal monster body, which is a big black bear more than ten feet tall, and the bear alone can kill the thousand-meter-high monster body. The mountain was broken abruptly, and with one sentence, the foundation of the mountain god was broken, and he was completely killed.

After this battle, the name of Black Bear Destroying Mountain God spread like wildfire, and quickly became famous throughout Dongjiang Province. This time, after hearing the prestige of the Demon King of Huangshan Mountain, he came to seek refuge and became a general under his command.

But this time, the already grumpy and pretentious black bear spirit couldn't bear it when he saw Chen Wu's arrogance in front of the army, with the arrogance of all the monster races like chickens and dogs.

He didn't even care about the orders of the Demon King of Huangshan Mountain, and went out to challenge directly.

Chen Wu was of course taken aback when he saw a figure more than three meters tall appearing in front of him, but he was prepared before, so he didn't lose his composure.

A silver light lit up, and then the spear in his hand stabbed out, directly attacking the black bear's heart.

When the black bear spirit saw it, he didn't dare to be negligent. He raised his two fat palms and slapped it. There was a clanging sound, and the spear was shaken, as if it was about to break at any moment.

When Chen Wu saw it, his heart moved, but he realized that although the black bear spirit's body was extremely powerful, its movements were quite slow. It was a weakness that could be exploited when it was slow to deal with its own attack.

At the moment, he stopped confronting him head-on, directly urged the steed under his crotch, and started to swim.

After turning the horse around a few times, Chen Wu found dozens of openings, stabbed with the silver spear in his hand, and picked at the black bear's opening.

What Chen Wu didn't expect was that the sharp silver spear pierced the body of the black bear spirit, and it bounced back without even scratching the skin, making his attack useless.

In the panic, his movements inevitably slowed down a bit. The black bear spirit found an opportunity and killed him with a grinning grin, so he had to rush to fight.

"It turns out that you are also a silver-like wax gun tip, a bauble item that can't even scratch the skin of me, the old bear."

When the black bear spirit found that Chen Wu couldn't even break through his own defense, he laughed wildly, but he didn't even care about the defense, and directly swung his arm and slapped him.

"He is really a rough-skinned and thick-skinned killer. It seems that he can't kill you without any means!"

Chen Wulang shouted loudly, his momentum soaring, which attracted everyone's attention.

Hei Xiong bounced his head meticulously, and couldn't help feeling a little nervous. As a monster, his intuition told him that the person in front of him was terribly terrifying.

However, his figure is so fat that he has already pounced on it. Wherever he can say it, he can accept it, and the treatment of flooded water is also applicable here.

In the widened pupils of the black bear spirit, the bright silver gun in Chen Wu's hand in front of him had turned blood-colored at some point, and the body of the gun exuded a strange bloody light under the sunlight.

After staring at it for a long time, there is actually a strange power that attracts people's soul and makes people addicted, people will fall into it without knowing it, and fascinate their minds.

The black bear spirit saw that the situation was not good, and directly activated his strongest move between life and death, which was also his natal supernatural power, transforming into a huge black bear more than ten feet tall.

This black bear was big and strong, many times bigger than before, and rushed towards Chen Wu with momentum, the momentum was like falling from a hill, so you couldn't look directly at it.

Just when the imperial army was worried and frightened, and the demon clan on the opposite side kept applauding, as if they had regained their face, Chen Wu, who was undoubtedly dead in their eyes, appeared behind the demon bear with a sway, standing upright in the middle of its brain Behind his neck, the bloody spear in his hand became more and more strange.

Stretching out his right hand, the long spear stabbed towards the back of the demon bear's head, and there was a muffled sound of the muffled flesh and blood being destroyed.

The back of the demon bear's head with extremely strong defenses, no matter whether it was flesh or bones, did not block the entry of the blood gun at all, and directly pierced into her brain.

Chen Wu twisted hard, and the blood gun emitted a strange blood light, and immediately began to absorb the power of the demon bear's flesh and soul.

In the blink of an eye, the demon bear was sucked into a mummy, its huge figure of tens of meters shrank to the extreme, only two or three meters left, sucked to death alive.

hiss~~

The monster soldier on the opposite side gasped.

The scene in front of me was too tortuous and tactful, shocking the world.

Whether it's the inevitable defeat of the demon bear, or Mr. Bao's death again, it's all touching, one after another.

But what is even more frightening is that Chen Wu's bloody long spear in front of him seems to have magical power, extremely evil, it actually directly devours the flesh and soul of the demon bear, it is even more demon than these demons.

On the contrary, the tens of thousands of imperial troops behind Chen Wu did not move at all, and they were not at all surprised by the strange and unusual scene in front of them.

That's right, they had seen the power and cruelty of this blood bin countless times before, and the emotion of horror had long since passed. Now that they saw it again, there would be no disturbance at all.

"Who dares to fight me?"

Chen Wu rode forward again, and challenged the monster soldiers on the opposite side.

It's just that this time there really wasn't any. Anyone who came out to fight, all the demon soldiers would be like turtles.

The strength shown in Chen Wu's two previous duels really horrified them.

General Gray Wolf and General Black Bear are all well-known strong men in the monster clan. Now they are easily killed by the opponents. The strongest one has not even passed ten moves. How can these monster clan people not be afraid? .

You know, apart from the Yellow Mountain Demon King, the strongest Heihu Lord in the army wants to defeat General Heixiong, and he needs a hundred tricks to win.

Facing a person who can take down General Black Bear with ten moves, no matter how it looks like a challenge is a dead word, after weighing the pros and cons, even if the Yaozu are known for their regret and fear of death, they will not rashly stand up and rush to find death.

"Who dares to fight me?"

Chen Wu challenged again several times, but no one responded after more than a dozen shouts, he could only curse a few times inwardly, and returned to the battle rather boringly.

Although Dou Jiang looks quite majestic and can bring unparalleled prestige to people, it still consumes a lot of energy for himself.

After passing the two monsters just now, Chen Wu consumed 60% to 70% of his true energy. Although he absorbed some of the essence of the black bear spirit to make up for it, he still felt tired after all.

If you continue to fight, there may be some mistakes, so let's just accept it!

Just such a fight that touched people's hearts and made the audience around excited, wishing to replace it, the curtain would come to an end, and the winner won infinite glory by stepping on the dead bones of failure.

And what follows will be the stage for countless soldiers on both sides, where they will show their bravery and win their own glory.
